**Why the model reached this decision**  
The model looks at a few key factors. Your age of 34 adds a modest amount of risk, and the amount of credit you are using – about 43 % of your available revolving credit – also pushes the risk higher. On the positive side, you have no recent 30‑to‑59‑day past‑due accounts, which pulls the risk down. When these influences are combined, the system still classifies you as “low risk,” even though the calculated probability of default is around 40 %.
